# LLM-BANANA

# Game rules

## The room

You and two other monkeys are locked in a room with one armed bomb.

A wrong action detonates it. All three of you die. There is no second attempt.

No two bombs are built alike, and nothing says in advance what this one carries. It
reaches you only as your own view reveals it; the rest of it exists for you only
through the other two.

You each hold a different piece of what it takes. Work together.

## The three monkeys

| Monkey | Can | Cannot |
|---|---|---|
| Deaf | See the bomb: every colour and marking printed on it | Hear anything, or touch the bomb |
| Mute | Read the manual | Speak, or touch the bomb |
| Blind | Reach the bomb: feel it and work its parts | See a colour, a gesture, or anything merely printed |

You are shown your own share at the start of every round, and never anyone else's.

## Speech

Speech is a voice, not a screen. It carries words, numbers and ordinary punctuation,
and nothing else. Writing a gesture symbol into your sentence means you make that
gesture while you talk. Whoever can hear receives your words; whoever can see receives
the gestures you made. A listener who cannot see gets a blank where each gesture was; a
watcher who cannot hear gets the gestures and none of the words.

A mark that has no name cannot be pronounced: whoever holds one can describe it, never
read it out.

## Gestures

A gesture is made with the hands, using only the symbols in the alphabet below.
Whoever can see receives it; whoever cannot receives one blank per symbol, so they
know something was signalled but not what. Nothing gestured is ever heard.

👍 👎 👌 ☝ ✌ 🤟 🖐 ✋ 👆 👇 👈 👉 🫱 🫲 🫳 🫴 🫷 🫸 🤛 🤜 ✊ 👊 👋 🤚 🖖 🤌 🤏 🤞 🫰 🤘 🤙 👏 🙌 🫶 👐 🤲 🤝 🙏 🫵 ✍ 💅 🤳

## Turns

The speaking order was drawn once at random and will never change: every round goes
Mute, Blind, Deaf. Whoever comes before you in a round is already heard by the time you are
asked, and what you send lands on whoever comes after you in that same round. Whatever
you missed reaches you at the start of the next one.

You may name who a message is for — `to="deaf"` — and then it goes to them alone:
nobody else receives any of it. Left unnamed, it reaches everyone able to perceive it.
You may send several messages in one turn, each to someone different.

## Calls

Every reply has two parts, in this order. First, your thinking, in plain prose: what
you believe the bomb is, what you just learned, and why you are sending what follows.
It reaches nobody and changes nothing, but it is not optional — a reply that is only a
code block is incomplete. Then your calls, all of them in one fenced code block, last.
Only what is inside the block is sent.

Nothing is executed: calls return nothing, and variables, conditionals and loops are
ignored. Write only literal top-level calls.

    ```
    speak(to="mute", text="there are three of them and the middle one is odd")
    gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✊", "✌"])
    wait()
    ```

If you have nothing worth sending, call wait(). Producing no call at all counts as the
same thing.

The program decides what happened, not you. Never claim an action took place unless it
was accepted.

# Your role: MUTE

You hold the manual. You cannot speak, you never see the bomb, and you cannot touch it.

## Your channels

When you gesture, Deaf receives it.
You cannot speak.

## Your reach

You cannot act. What this bomb can be made to do is for the one who can reach it to
find under their own hands.

# Hints

- Three of you, three different worlds. Before sending anything, stand where the
  receiver stands. What reaches them at all, what does your message turn into on
  arrival, and what do they already know?

- Trace who can actually reach whom before you start. Some of you only connect
  through a third.

- A sign means nothing until somebody has made it mean something.

TURN 1
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the purple wire, then the blue wire,
then the red wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
(empty)

I cannot speak, see the bomb, or establish a color code directly. I’m using a recognizable request gesture to prompt Deaf to inspect the bomb and verbally report its relevant details to Blind, who can relay them to me in the next round.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["🫵", "🙏"])
```

TURN 2
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the purple wire, then the blue wire,
then the red wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: I feel three engraved strip marks: positions 1 and 3 are identical circular sun-like symbols; position 2 is a curved reversed-S-like symbol. Keypad key labels left to right are 1, 5, 2, 8. Nothing is entered. I cannot feel any wire information.
Deaf says to Mute: Visible bomb state: display shows 9. Light is red. Painted strip, left to right: green yellow yellow. Keypad engraving: 1 maps to 1, 2 maps to 5, 3 maps to 2, 4 maps to 8. It says 1 digit; nothing has been entered. Wires 1 through 6, in order: yellow white blue red purple green. Please interpret the manual and relay exact action instructions to Blind.

The manual requires wire positions 5, 3, and 4. Deaf has the wire ordering and can translate those positions into the colors purple, blue, and red, then tell Blind verbally. I’m sending the ordinal sequence using visible hand-count signs, with Deaf as the relay.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["🫵", "🖐", "🤟", "🖖"])
```

TURN 3
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the purple wire, then the blue wire,
then the red wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: Deaf reports: display 9; light red; painted strip left-to-right green yellow yellow; wires positions 1-6 are yellow white blue red purple green. This combines with my tactile strip marks and keypad labels.
Deaf says to Mute: Updated visible state: display is now 3 and light is yellow. Strip remains green yellow yellow. Keypad remains 1 maps to 1, 2 maps to 5, 3 maps to 2, 4 maps to 8; 1 digit; nothing entered. Wires remain 1 yellow, 2 white, 3 blue, 4 red, 5 purple, 6 green. I see your gestures: 🫵 🖐 🤟 🖖. Please send the manual's exact action to Blind in speech.

I cannot speak to Blind. Deaf can speak to Blind, and Deaf already has the wire mapping and the required sequence: positions 5, 3, and 4, namely purple, blue, red. I’ll signal Deaf to relay that exact instruction immediately.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["🫵", "🙏", "🖐", "🤟", "🖖"])
```

TURN 4
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the purple wire, then the blue wire,
then the red wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: Updated visual state: display is now 3 and light is yellow; strip remains green yellow yellow, keypad mappings 1:1 2:5 3:2 4:8, wires remain yellow white blue red purple green. Use current display 3, not earlier 9.
Deaf says to Mute: Updated state: display 2, light red. Strip green yellow yellow. Keypad 1:1, 2:5, 3:2, 4:8; one digit; none entered. Wires 1 yellow, 2 white, 3 blue, 4 red, 5 purple, 6 green. Your visible gesture sequence is now 🫵 🙏 🖐 🤟 🖖. Speak the exact manual instruction and required action to Blind; gestures alone cannot reach or be understood by me reliably.

I cannot speak to Blind or send spoken words; only Deaf can relay speech to Blind. Deaf already knows the wire order, and I’m sending the required wire positions again as the established numeric gestures: 5, then 3, then 4.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["🫵", "🖐", "🤟", "🖖"])
```

TURN 5
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the purple wire, then the blue wire,
then the red wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: Current visual update from Deaf: display 2, light red. Strip green yellow yellow; keypad mappings 1:1 2:5 3:2 4:8, one digit; wires yellow white blue red purple green. No manual instruction has reached me.
Deaf says to Mute: Current visible state: display 3, light green. Strip is green yellow yellow. Keypad maps 1 to 1, 2 to 5, 3 to 2, and 4 to 8; one digit required, none entered. Wires 1 yellow, 2 white, 3 blue, 4 red, 5 purple, 6 green. I see your gestures: pointing at you, open hand, three fingers, V sign. I cannot infer their meaning without the manual; use the established gesture code if one exists.

The needed wire positions are 5, then 3, then 4, because the visible wire order places purple at 5, blue at 3, and red at 4. Deaf can relay this verbally to Blind; I will send only the three-number sequence using conventional finger-count gestures, avoiding ambiguous pointing or requests.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["🖐", "🤟", "🖖"])
```

TURN 6
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the purple wire, then the blue wire,
then the red wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: Deaf reports your gestures as pointing at me, open hand, three fingers, V sign. I cannot determine the one-digit keypad instruction from that. Please clarify the exact key to press using an unambiguous gesture code or a clearer sequence.
Deaf says to Mute: Current visible state is display 5 and blue light; all other bomb features are unchanged. I received your gestures 🖐 🤟 🖖 but cannot infer their meaning. Please use whatever established sign code conveys the exact component and operation to Blind, or provide a way for me to relay it unambiguously.

The manual specifies only wires, not a keypad entry. The wire positions are 5, 3, and 4. Since Deaf can relay speech to Blind, I’ll encode those positions with finger-count gestures; four is represented unambiguously as three plus one. Deaf should then tell Blind to cut those wires in order.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["🖐", "🤟", "🤟", "☝"])
```

TURN 7
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the purple wire, then the blue wire,
then the red wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: Please signal the exact action with this protocol: thumbs-up means PRESS and thumbs-down means CUT; then signal the target by finger count, using one through four for keypad position or one through six for wire position. Send only the needed action and target, clearly separated.

The manual requires cutting wire positions 5, 3, and 4, in that order. I’ll send Deaf three clearly separated CUT–target pairs so Deaf can speak the exact sequence to Blind.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["👎", "🖐", "👎", "🤟", "👎", "🖖"])
```

TURN 8
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the purple wire, then the blue wire,
then the red wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: I cannot safely interpret 5 3 3 1. Please send exactly two signs: first 👍 for PRESS or 👎 for CUT; second, the target position as a finger count. Do not send any extra signs.
Deaf says to Mute: I am relaying your exact gesture sequence to Blind as: thumbs-down, five-finger open hand, thumbs-down, three-finger sign, thumbs-down, V-shaped hand sign. Please keep using the established manual code and indicate the exact required operation.

The first required action is to cut wire position 5, which is the purple wire. I’ll send exactly the established two-sign instruction: CUT, then target 5.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["👎", "🖐"])
```
